name: pulse-spa
description: The clinical workspace of Pulse (ADR-0029). The npm packages the ClojureScript build bundles: React, keycloak-js (the same line as the Keycloak server) and shadow-cljs; and axe-core, which only the acceptance journey (`bb spa:journey`) uses and the release does not bundle. Every version is exact, and `npm ci` installs what the lock says.
